visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation featuring a plump yellow and white cat sitting in a vibrant field with pink flowers and rolling green hills under a bright sky. The cat is shown chasing a yellow butterfly with wide, expressive eyes. The scene shifts as a hand holding a slipper enters from the right, and the cat is later depicted with a dark bruise on its cheek against a plain blue background, looking shocked and hurt. (2) The narrative transitions to the cat's life as a stray. It is seen running and walking on a wet road during a heavy rainstorm, its facial expression showing extreme fatigue and worry. It hides inside a soggy cardboard box placed next to dark, lumpy trash bags. Two menacing cats with sharp, triangular eyes glare at it, followed by two human characters peering into its hiding spot. The cat is then shown with a bleeding cut on its forehead under dark, swirling storm clouds. (3) The cat encounters two friendly male characters on a street, looking up at them with a mixture of surprise and hope. The animation style remains consistent with soft lines and pastel colors. Subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame to narrate the meeting and the cat receiving a name, marking the end of its time in the rain. (4) The video transitions from animation to a real-life studio shot. A person's hand with a silver ring holds a physical manga book titled '阿瑪流浪記'. The hand flips through the pages quickly, showing various comic panels that depict the scenes previously seen in the animation. The background is a clean, neutral indoor setting, and the video concludes with the book cover prominently displayed alongside a website URL overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, melancholic piano melody that establishes a narrative and slightly emotional atmosphere. A male narrator speaks in clear, professional Traditional Chinese, describing the early life of a cat with a calm and steady speech rate. There is no background noise, indicating a clean studio mix. (2) As the visuals depict the cat's stray life in the rain, the narrator's tone remains empathetic but steady. A subtle, high-frequency white noise texture simulating rain is added to the background at 0:12. The piano continues its melodic loop, providing a consistent emotional floor without becoming intrusive. (3) The energy of the voice increases slightly as the narration turns toward the cat's rescue. The music remains the same, but the speaker's pitch variability increases to highlight the turning point in the story. (4) Upon transitioning to the real-world product shot, the narration becomes more energetic and promotional. At 0:47, a distinct, high-transient SFX of paper pages rustling and flipping is heard as the hand opens the manga book. The piano music then fades out smoothly alongside the voice.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a sentimental animated back story of a well-known character (the cat Ama) to build emotional resonance before revealing a new physical product. By depicting the cat's early hardships and eventual rescue, it creates a 'origin story' that justifies and adds value to the 2025 manga book '阿瑪流浪記'. The ultimate intent is to drive pre-orders for the book through the specified website.
